decisions.candidate: Direct byte-line loop and literal decoded-string comparison
decisions.rationale: JSON Lines offers record-at-a-time framing; byte I/O avoids locale/newline rewriting. Preserve original matching record bytes, adding LF only when final matched line has no terminator.
decisions.complexity_cost: One-record parsing and explicit flush after each match.
decisions.scale_fit: One process, memory O(largest record), no accumulation.
decisions.revisit_trigger: Revisit parser/runtime if measured throughput or record size exceeds operational bounds.

decisions.candidate: Strict input with fail-fast safe diagnostics
decisions.rationale: Reject blank/invalid UTF-8/BOM/syntax/nonstandard numeric constants; duplicate keys rejected by hook to avoid ambiguous match. Valid non-object JSON is a nonmatch. Catch parser ValueError/RecursionError as record failures.
decisions.complexity_cost: Explicit decoder hooks, global line count, safe diagnostics.
decisions.scale_fit: Logs may contain sensitive content; do not echo raw record. Previously emitted matches remain on failure.
decisions.revisit_trigger: Add explicit continue mode only if operators ask for partial recovery and metrics.

decisions.candidate: Python 3.11+ single script, standard library only
decisions.rationale: json.tool demonstrates standard-library local JSONL CLI primitives. The job needs no package graph under declared runtime assumption.
decisions.complexity_cost: Python runtime prerequisite; no installer or dependencies.
decisions.scale_fit: Small local operator workflow; not zero-runtime installation.
decisions.revisit_trigger: If operators lack Python or need signed binaries, revisit compiled distribution with research.

decisions.candidate: Use ordinary jq invocation as the whole product
decisions.rationale: jq solves general filtering and offers a single binary, but ordinary input framing is whitespace-separated values and its expression UX is broader than the fixed literal-field job; strict physical-line diagnostics need more wrapper policy.
decisions.complexity_cost: Extra expression and wrapper contract despite excellent general tool.
decisions.scale_fit: Strong option if jq is already installed and strict framing is unnecessary.
decisions.revisit_trigger: Revisit if scope changes to general expressions or deployment forbids Python.
